headline: Congress approved reappointing John W. McCarter to another term as a citizen regent of the Smithsonian Institution's Board of Regents.
what_it_does: This joint resolution, enacted as Public Law 113-91 in March 2014, renews John W. McCarter's appointment as a citizen regent on the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution. The Smithsonian's governing board oversees the museums and research centers that the institution runs. The official summary does not describe any other changes to the board's rules or duties.
when_it_takes_effect: The reappointment took effect when the law was enacted on March 21, 2014.
